summary: Iteration 6 — full backend + frontend verification of (a) shopping-bag exclusion across BI endpoints, (b) Facebook Graph contract endpoints, (c) NBA enrichment in Daily Call List, (d) Vivo editorial login hero, and (e) Manager Social tab Facebook connect card. Backend pytest 19/19 PASS. Frontend smoke 100% PASS for all required testids. NO regressions in existing /api/social/* endpoints (8/8).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1494 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting Facebook routes (status/discover/pages/sync) into a dedicated facebook_router.py and the NBA/call-list block into a dashboard_router.py (mirrors the existing social.py / facebook_sync.py pattern).

_filter_products is applied at four call-sites by name; consider moving it into a single response post-processor (decorator or response_model wrapper) so future BI endpoints can never ship without the bag filter again.

Dashboard call list rows render 'AI · HIGH/MEDIUM' urgency chips with [data-testid='nba-urgency-{id}'] but the inline 'call'/'message' action text has no matching [data-testid='nba-action-{id}']. Spec only required nba-urgency, so this is non-blocking, but for parity (and to allow per-row action assertions) consider adding it on the same span.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login hero, FB connect card + form, dashboard NBA urgency badges all verified)
